$comment: The Great Storybook's pages and quests (SC-R04-02), as the server needs them. A page is derived from a record the castle's content already writes; it is never stored. This file mirrors react/src/features/great-storybook/pages.ts (STORYBOOK_PAGES) and GREAT_STORYBOOK_QUEST_IDS, which are authored there; a Vitest test fails if they differ.

pages.title: The First Story

pages.title: The Pattern Lock

pages.title: What Was Waiting
